findings.title: NPE fix is incomplete: three getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference modelSupplier.get() without a null check
findings.body: This PR fixes the concurrent-deletion NPE in getSubGroupsCount() by checking modelSupplier.get() for null (the supplier returns null when the group was deleted from the database after the cached entry was loaded). However, the exact same race exists in the three sibling methods getSubGroupsStream(String search, Integer firstResult, Integer maxResults) (line 256), getSubGroupsStream(Integer firstResult, Integer maxResults) (line 262), and getSubGroupsStream(String search, Boolean exact, Integer firstResult, Integer maxResults) (line 268): all three call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check. If a group is deleted concurrently while one of these paginated sub-group endpoints is being served (the scenario from issue #40368), they still throw a NullPointerException. These methods should apply the same null handling as getSubGroupsCount (e.g., return Stream.empty() or delegate consistently).

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, so the assertion on caughtExceptions races with in-flight requests
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti, the spawned reader thread loops until deletedAll is set, but the test thread sets deletedAll (line 155) and immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty (line 157) without joining the reader thread. The reader may still be executing a request at that point; an exception it throws a moment later is added to caughtExceptions after the assertion has already passed, so the test can silently miss the very failure it was written to catch (making it both flaky and weak as a regression test). Conversely, the reader thread may also still be running when the test method ends. The test should keep a reference to the Thread and call join() before asserting on caughtExceptions.
